notes.title: Still There Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are excited to let you know that [b]Still There[/b] will be releasing on 20th November 2019 here on Steam! 

Are you ready to manage the Bento space-lighthouse and its monotone routines, and meet Gorky - the stations wacky AI? And [i](arguably)[/i] more importantly, are you ready to find out the truth about what happened to your character Karl all those years ago that lead him to live this solitary life to begin with? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35131894/34f71d949d85e4b0a4275b2b2b09ddaf2e564213.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1063490/Still_There/

[b]"Yes Captain, I'm ready!"[/b] - you say? Great! If you haven't already - wishlist [b]Still There[/b] ahead of release and prepare for the ultimate indie roller-coaster mashup that will challenge your mind, tug on your heartstrings and make you question the fundamental questions in life and if you're [b]Still There[/b] at all...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35131894/ebbbd39b038190eb836f0e679f1fae57aaff580d.jpg[/img]

- The [b]Still There[/b] Team.
